_comment: Explicit old-slug -> new-slug map for renamed tutorials. Each entry needs (1) a stub page at the old slug (JS redirect that keeps ?query and #hash), and (2) a matching 301 line in docs/_redirects for hosts that honour it. `node scripts/tutorial-policy.cjs lint` checks all three agree. Old slugs listed here are exempt from the protected-name check (they exist only so inbound links keep working).
